summary: `pnpm hygiene`, `pnpm worktrees:prune` and `pnpm db:migrate` check the runtime before loading their `.ts` rules module; a direct `node scripts/<entry>.mjs` names both versions instead of a loader error naming the wrong file.
reader_impact: Nobody outside the repository — operator scripts; on a host below the declared engine the people who run them get one sentence naming both versions, from `pnpm` through the pre-hook and from a bare `node` through the entry point.
